title: Stereoacuity after photorefractive keratectomy in myopia

license.statement: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (article <license license-type='CC BY-NC-ND'>); private: record not published

indication: myopia or myopic astigmatism (inclusion: preoperative mean spherical equivalent and cylinder within the stated limits, stable refraction, BCVA 20/20 or better)

groups.description: Alcohol-assisted PRK (Technolas 217z flying-spot excimer, wavefront-guided personalized or aspheric ablation) with mitomycin C 0.02% and bandage lens; both eyes of 48 patients; prospective interventional case series

series.notes: mean ± standard deviation (range) per Table 1 footnote a; the range in parentheses is not used; per-visit n not reported (96 eyes of 48 patients)

exclusions.what: Ranges printed in parentheses in Table 1 cells
exclusions.reason: ranges are not admissible (only the leading mean is read)
not refraction; text values are not citable cells

notes: Target refraction is not stated; recorded as unstated.
Method: Methods list manifest and full-cycloplegic refraction preoperatively; Results describe the tabulated refractive errors as the manifest refractive errors; recorded as manifest.
Two ablation profiles (wavefront-guided personalized and aspheric) are described in Methods but outcomes are tabulated only for the whole cohort, which is extracted.
Both eyes of each patient were treated and included (96 eyes of 48 patients; fellow-eye correlation).
Table 1 also tabulates cylinder, UCVA, BCVA (logMAR) and higher-order aberrations (not extracted; schema 1.0.0 has no such series).
